title: Figure 34. Percentage of Impacts in 5-Degree Sectors (Atlas IIAS)
description: Semi-log line graph plotting Percent in 5-deg Sector (%) against Angle from Flight Path, Theta (deg), labeled "Data for Atlas IIAS" with B = 1000, for A = 1.0 through 5.0. The A = 1.0 curve is nearly flat, indicating an essentially uniform impact-density function. Text below discusses the Gross Flight Deviation Failure (GFDF) mode used in the LARA program at the Western Range and gives equation (8). Captioned "Figure 34. Percentage of Impacts in 5-Degree Sectors".
